   | THE OPPORTUNITIES DOCK
Your go-to for grants, funding, and investment opportunities- so you don’t waste time searching. |
Bupa Foundation Green Community Grants
Funding: £500–£2,000 | Eligibility: Registered charities and non-profits in the UK, Republic of Ireland, and Channel Islands running projects connecting communities with green spaces | Description: Small grants supporting community-led initiatives that improve human and planetary health, from urban gardens and food-growing schemes to accessible green spaces. | Deadline: June 30, 2026 | Link: https://www.groundwork.org.uk/bupa-foundation-green-grants/

 |
TiE Women Program 2026
Funding: Up to $50,000 equity-free cash prize | Eligibility: Women-founded or co-founded startups (min. 33% female equity stake), registered after 1 January 2019, actively raising funds, open globally | Description: A global program empowering women entrepreneurs through equity-free prizes, mentoring, investor access, and a worldwide platform, spanning learning, community, and scalability support across TiE's 61 chapters. | Deadline: 25 June 2026 | Link: https://tiewomen.org/

 |
Social & Criminal Justice Grants – Charles Hayward Foundation
Funding: £15,000–£25,000 per year (up to 3 years) | Eligibility: Registered charities operating in the British Isles focused on criminal justice prevention or rehabilitation | Description: Grants supporting charities working to keep people out of the criminal justice system and helping those within it rebuild their lives through recovery and reintegration. | Deadline: 18 September 2026 | Link: https://charleshaywardfoundation.org.uk/grants/social-criminal-justice/

 |
CliFi Story Grant – Net Zero Institute
Funding: $1,000 | Eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior experience in climate, writing, or TV required | Description: A grant by Boston Climate Week's Net Zero Institute for original short stories, TV pitches/scripts, or mini videos imagining a binge-worthy, post-climate-crisis future, character-driven, hopeful, and set in a net-zero world. | Deadline: 30 August 2026 | Link

 |
Mobilize Power Fund – Third Wave Fund
Eligibility: Gender justice organizations in the US responding to unanticipated incidents or threats within the last six months; budget shortfalls or pre-planned events are not prioritized | Description: A rapid-response fund supporting gender justice organizing, healing justice, mutual aid, direct action, and emergency safety needs — applications accepted via written form, video, or phone on a monthly cycle. | Deadline: Rolling monthly cycles, next deadline 7 July 2026 | Link: https://www.thirdwavefund.org/mobilize-power-fund

Social Shifters Global Innovation Challenge 2026
Funding: Up to $15,000 USD (multiple awards) | Eligibility: Young founders aged 18–30 leading an active project or startup delivering social or environmental impact, aligned with at least one UN SDG | Description: A global grant competition supporting young social entrepreneurs with funding, free application support, and ongoing access to fellowships, paid work, and networking opportunities. | Deadline: 31 August 2026 | Link

 |
2027 RISK Award – "Homes at Risk: Climate Resilience for Informal Settlements" Funding: Up to €100,000 | Eligibility: NGOs running projects in low- and middle-income countries addressing climate disaster risks (flooding, heat, storms) in informal or semi-formal urban settlements | Description: A biennial award by Munich Re Foundation and UNDRR supporting innovative local initiatives that build climate resilience at household and community level in underserved urban areas, anchored in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction. | Deadline: 31 July 2026 (Phase I) | Link: https://www.munichre-foundation.org/en/climate-adaptation/risk-award/news/2027-risk-award-call.html

 |
The Global Good Fund Fellowship
Funding: $10,000 development grant + executive coaching and mentorship | Eligibility: Open globally to social entrepreneurs working toward a sustainable and just future | Description: A fellowship combining financial support with high-level leadership development, pairing social entrepreneurs with executive coaches and mentors to accelerate their venture's impact. | Deadline: July 1, 2026 | Link: https://globalgoodfund.org/fellowship-program/
